Title: Vating System
Features: 🔒 Secure Voter Registration: When a voter registers, they instantly receive an email with their unique voter ID and password, ensuring a smooth and secure voting experience.
🔍 Voter Verification: Voters can verify their registration status and eligibility to vote by entering their voter ID and password.
📧 Automated Email Notifications: In addition to receiving login credentials, voters are notified at each stage of the process, including registration confirmation and voting success.
📊 Real-Time Vote Counting: The system provides real-time results as votes are cast, ensuring transparency and accuracy in the election process.
👤 Admin Dashboard: Administrators have access to an intuitive dashboard for managing voters, tracking activity, and viewing detailed election reports.
📱 Mobile-Responsive Design: Voters can easily access the platform from any device—whether on desktop, tablet, or smartphone—for a seamless experience.
🔑 Two-Factor Authentication : Added an extra layer of security with 2FA to safeguard the integrity of the voting process.
